verdict.rationale: ROS 2 offers building blocks for autonomous background processes: a launch system that coordinates multiple nodes, nodes with managed lifecycles, and actions for long-running tasks with feedback and cancellation. These are developer primitives for writing your own long-running robotics programs, not a ready-made automation feature. Missing for 10: any user-facing way to define, schedule, or trigger background automations without writing node code; documentation of supervising or monitoring unattended runs; independent corroboration that this fits an AI-native automation workflow.
